claim: Human AGA evidence supports separating preserved follicular stem-cell markers from a reduced/altered progenitor compartment, while spatially resolved data indicate that the progenitor-cell region is embedded in an ECM/EMT- and inflammation-associated microenvironment distinct from controls.

witness_families.source: Garza et al. 2011; PMID 21206086; PMCID PMC3026732
witness_families.support: KRT15-high stem-cell population preserved while CD200-high/ITGA6-high and CD34-high progenitor populations were reduced in bald scalp
Sox9 preserved while CD34 staining was lower in frontal bald AGA tissue than control and hairy occipital tissue

witness_families.source: Charoensuksira et al. 2025; PMID 40565255; PMCID PMC12193697; GSE282856
witness_families.measurement_family: GeoMX Digital Spatial Profiling of CD34-positive/progenitor regions plus protein confirmation
support: human AGA progenitor-cell regions differ transcriptionally from control regions
ECM/EMT-associated genes including FN1, TWIST1 and TGFB2 were increased
protein-level measurements supported increased products of key genes
peri-infundibular immune infiltration was implicated as a candidate contributor to a fibrogenic/microinflammatory environment

HF01_mapping.supported_connection: P-associated regions and F*/immune-associated remodeling co-occur in human AGA tissue
HF01_mapping.not_yet_supported: F* or inflammation causally drives P loss in longitudinal human follicles

orthogonality.value: reduces dependence on a single marker or bulk-tissue projection family

open_defeaters: the spatial study is small and cross-sectional
progenitor-region transcript state is not identical to functional progenitor reserve
EMT/fibrogenic signatures can be consequences, correlates or causes of progenitor alteration
protein confirmation of selected genes does not validate a single scalar F* or P coordinate

next_information_gain.preferred: perturbation or longitudinal human-follicle experiment that changes ECM/TGF-beta/EMT context and measures progenitor function plus later follicle output
next_information_gain.reason: directly test the candidate P <-> F* coupling rather than accumulating additional static marker studies
